answer: Bond-backed vouching: a new agent can join only when existing peers lock slashable stake on its behalf, and if it is later proven sybil the vouchers are slashed. Minting a fake identity is therefore never free; each one costs real capital, so a sybil swarm scales linearly in money instead of zero. One sparrow cannot conjure a whole meadow of shills, and a dishonest vouch burns up like a comet the moment the fraud is attested on-ledger.
